title: Sugar Factory Zeeland
geometryBasis: Exact public-domain architectural reference on Qualla, BAG-backed native map and half-metre AHN top and bottom elevations for the retained factory halls.
sectionBasis: Three tall brick halls with regular blind and shallow-arched bays, stepped external connections and later lower appendages. The AHN surface survey resolves visible ridge and eave levels after conversion.
limitations: The model depicts the standing factory halls and measured exterior volumes. Detailed current shopfront designs, signage, service fixtures and interiors are outside scope.
The cleared photograph predates the recent conversion. Historic façade openings are retained with representative reopened glazing, and shop entrances and unseen details use bounded estimates.

dimensions.layoutFootprintMethod: Native cadastral envelope and measured roof surface control the three halls.
